button.label: Save
button.name: cine_setup_save
button.tool_tip: Built-in setups are read-only. Type a new setup name to enable Save.

combo_box.name: cine_easing
combo_box.tool_tip: Transition curve used for setup loads, random cycling and live edits.

check_box.label: Random cycle
check_box.name: cine_random_cycle
check_box.tool_tip: Automatically cross-fade to a random master setup on an interval.

check_box.label: Manual
check_box.name: cine_manual
check_box.tool_tip: Manual mode: forces effects (FX) off and locks the selector so per-light aim, exposure and colour stay hand-controlled. Uncheck to use effects.

check_box.label: Easy mode
check_box.name: cine_easy_mode
check_box.tool_tip: On uses the simplified exposure controls. Off enables Advanced EV and Ratio controls.

slider.name: cine_easy_drama
slider.tool_tip: KEY:FILL stop difference: 0 is flat, 2 is natural, and 5 is noir.

slider.name: cine_easy_warmth
slider.tool_tip: Relative colour-temperature trim in mireds: + warms and - cools all lights.

slider.name: cine_easy_cone_width
slider.tool_tip: Set all rig lights to a narrow Snoot, medium Standard, or wide Softbox beam.

button.name: cine_easy_cone_width_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset all rig cone widths to default

slider.name: cine_easy_cone_feather
slider.tool_tip: Soften or sharpen the visible edge of every volumetric projector cone.

button.name: cine_easy_cone_feather_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset cone edge feather to default

text.tool_tip: Volumetric shaft length: visible airborne beam length for all volumetric projector shafts.

slider.name: cine_easy_shaft_length
slider.tool_tip: Volumetric shaft length in metres for every projector beam. 0 follows each projector's full light range; surface illumination is unchanged. Hover and scroll the mouse wheel for 0.1 m steps.

combo_box.name: cine_easy_flare_preset
combo_box.tool_tip: Applies a full look (streak, ghosts, halo, rings, circles, iris, arc) and snaps back to this sentinel. Master strength/intensity are not touched by presets.

text.tool_tip: Live PBR reflection probe captured around the target rig.

slider.name: cine_easy_probe_radius
slider.tool_tip: PBR reflection probe influence radius in metres (spherical). Hover and scroll the mouse wheel for 0.25 m steps.

check_box.label: Probe
check_box.name: cine_easy_probe_enable
check_box.tool_tip: Capture a spherical environment-only PBR reflection probe around one rig. Costs six cubemap views per frame while enabled.

check_box.label: Gizmo
check_box.name: cine_easy_probe_gizmo
check_box.tool_tip: Draw the live probe's spherical influence boundary.

text.name: cine_radius_label
text.tool_tip: Full brightness compensation to 9.1 m; projector reach ends at 20 m.

spinner.name: cine_radius
spinner.tool_tip: Orbit radius. Full brightness compensation up to 9.1 m; from 9.1–20 m the light dims as the 20 m projector reach cap bites; past 20 m the subject leaves the light's reach entirely. Scale-aware geometry grows with the subject, or grows with a spread anchor group, until the same cap.

slider.name: cine_master_temp
slider.tool_tip: Relative colour-temperature trim in mireds: + warms, - cools all lights together; each light keeps its own gel. 0 = off.

combo_box.name: cine_track_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Skeleton follows the pose (chest bone); Body-stable ignores in-place animation and centres on the body position.

check_box.label: Catchlight
check_box.name: cine_catchlight
check_box.tool_tip: Eye-level specular accent. It never casts shadows or consumes a shadow slot.

button.name: cine_catchlight_angle_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset to the classic 11 o'clock position

text.value: Yaw / Pitch remain pristine transforms; setup loads keep this aim.

check_box.label: Auto-raise Max Spot Shadows
check_box.name: cine_auto_shadow_slots
check_box.tool_tip: Raise-only across all enabled rig instances, capped by the GPU. Restores the pre-raise value when the rigs go dark unless another control changed it.

button.label: Allow 2 spot shadows
button.name: cine_shadow_fixit
button.tool_tip: Raises Max Spot Shadows so every requesting rig projector gets a shadow slot. Each slot renders an extra shadow map per frame.

slider.name: cine_key_cone_width
slider.tool_tip: KEY cone: narrow Snoot, medium Standard, or wide Softbox.

combo_box.name: cine_key_flicker
combo_box.tool_tip: Seeded, scrub-safe practical light behavior layered over this light, including rig-wide FX.

slider.name: cine_key_flicker_amount
slider.tool_tip: Practical flicker strength. Zero is an exact no-modulation path.

spinner.name: cine_key_shadow_soft
spinner.tool_tip: Per-projector penumbra scale. 0 uses the current global shadow behavior.

check_box.label: Ratio lock
check_box.name: cine_ratio_lock
check_box.tool_tip: Drive FILL EV from KEY EV minus the selected stop ratio.

slider.name: cine_ratio
slider.tool_tip: KEY:FILL stop difference, from 1:1 at zero to 32:1 at five stops.

slider.name: cine_fill_cone_width
slider.tool_tip: FILL cone: narrow Snoot, medium Standard, or wide Softbox.

combo_box.name: cine_fill_flicker
combo_box.tool_tip: Seeded, scrub-safe practical light behavior layered over this light, including rig-wide FX.

slider.name: cine_fill_flicker_amount
slider.tool_tip: Practical flicker strength. Zero is an exact no-modulation path.

spinner.name: cine_fill_shadow_soft
spinner.tool_tip: Per-projector penumbra scale. 0 uses the current global shadow behavior.

slider.name: cine_rim_cone_width
slider.tool_tip: RIM cone: narrow Snoot, medium Standard, or wide Softbox.

combo_box.name: cine_rim_flicker
combo_box.tool_tip: Seeded, scrub-safe practical light behavior layered over this light, including rig-wide FX.

slider.name: cine_rim_flicker_amount
slider.tool_tip: Practical flicker strength. Zero is an exact no-modulation path.

spinner.name: cine_rim_shadow_soft
spinner.tool_tip: Per-projector penumbra scale. 0 uses the current global shadow behavior.

slider.name: cine_bg_cone_width
slider.tool_tip: BG cone: narrow Snoot, medium Standard, or wide Softbox.

combo_box.name: cine_bg_flicker
combo_box.tool_tip: Seeded, scrub-safe practical light behavior layered over this light, including rig-wide FX.

slider.name: cine_bg_flicker_amount
slider.tool_tip: Practical flicker strength. Zero is an exact no-modulation path.

spinner.name: cine_bg_shadow_soft
spinner.tool_tip: Per-projector penumbra scale. 0 uses the current global shadow behavior.

check_box.label: Use fixture
check_box.name: cine_fixture_mode
check_box.tool_tip: Use Kelvin, a three-gel stack and modeled source size instead of the legacy colour profile and single gel.

combo_box.name: cine_fixture_preset
combo_box.tool_tip: Seeds this light's Kelvin, source size, beam and suggested gels; later edits are independent.

spinner.name: cine_fixture_source_size
spinner.tool_tip: Effective emitting diameter. Bigger and closer produces softer shadows without changing EV.

text.value: CT gels add in mireds; correction and color gels multiply. KEY source size drives the single catchlight scale.

combo_box.name: cine_gobo_library
combo_box.tool_tip: Categorized achromatic breakup library for the selected Fixture 2.0 light.

icon.name: cine_gobo_preview
icon.tool_tip: Sharp source thumbnail. Projection automatically uses sharp, medium or heavy pre-blur from modeled softness.

text.value: Cookie blur follows source size; Rotating Fan uses presentation-time UV rotation.

combo_box.name: cine_flare_preset
combo_box.tool_tip: Applies a full look (streak, ghosts, halo, rings, circles, iris, arc) and snaps back to this sentinel. Master strength/intensity are not touched by presets.

text.tool_tip: One-knob brightness scale over the whole composited flare (sun and rig sources together), independent of preset.
Projector-only flare master. Values above 0 suppress the legacy sun/moon flare; 0 restores the independent sun/moon path.
Brightness multiplier applied to every active rig-projector flare source.
How much brighter than a lit surface a spot must be to flare. Lit floors/walls never flare; raise to require only your brightest light sources; lower toward 0 for dimmer emissive fixtures.
Diffraction-spike star radiating from each flare source. 0 disables it.
Polygonal (n-gon) iris-ghost chain marching along the source-to-center axis.
Chromatic dispersion rings around the source.
Spectral lens circles ringing outward through the optical axis.
Partial spectral arc on the far side of frame center.
Red/blue radial split on the ghost discs.
Red/blue radius split on the halo ring.
Barrel (positive) or pincushion (negative) distortion of the ghost/halo/iris/ring/circle/arc layers. Streak and starburst stay straight.
Blends the anamorphic streak toward a tip color with distance from the source.
Pulls each element's tint toward the light source's own color instead of the screen-sampled pixel under it. Useful for gelled rig projectors.
Optical fade time in seconds after a rig projector's rendered shaft ends. Longer values leave a softer camera-response tail.

text.value: Scene setting; not saved in Setups

combo_box.name: cine_live_probe_target

spinner.name: cine_live_probe_offset
spinner.tool_tip: Vertical offset from the target rig centre.
